title: Temporary wastewater service for new Waikapū school
summary: Bill 116, an agreement for temporary wastewater service to a new Central Maui school, passed 9-0 on November 25. It is a backup in case the county's new wastewater plant, projected to start in late 2029 or later, is not running when the school opens in 2031. Then the existing Wailuku-Kahului plant would take up to 14,500 gallons a day, subject to capacity.
